_help: Minimap window (M) and world map window (O) boxes in 1366x768 space. Minimap: x,y,w,h is the window; inset* cut the map well out of the official frame; nameX/nameY is the map name, streetX/streetY the street name; closeX/closeY the X button. World map: wx,wy,ww,wh is the window; worldX/worldY the map art inside it; titleH is the title strip height; infoX/infoY the MAP INFO text; wcloseX/wcloseY the X button.
